profile.name: Invoice Helper
profile.description: Extracts totals, due dates and supplier names from invoice PDFs you paste as text.
profile.readme:
# Invoice Helper

Invoice Helper reads invoice text and returns the supplier, total amount and due date as a short table, so small teams can log bills fast.

## Features

- Supplier, total, due date, currency
- Handles AUD, USD, EUR

## Usage

Paste the invoice text and ask for the totals.

## Limitations

Text only; no scanned images.
